data.summary: the base is red on doc lint: a task file link of mine resolved outside the repo root. doc lint caught it in the main checkout and not in the worktree, which is worth knowing - both are the same tree at the same commit, so the difference is the working directory the relative path is resolved from

measured, not guessed: doc lint fails on this broken link at BOTH 4a62ada and d67523b, and in a detached worktree as well as in this checkout, and the fences in the file balance. One earlier run in the same session reported OK on the same bytes; I cannot reproduce the reason, so I am not going to assert one. What is verified is that the base was published red on doc lint and that the gate does catch it on re-check - which is the only reason it is not still red.

data.next: Next unclaimed work is STATE-next-actions.md item 2(d): reconcile._is_vendored reuses the line-cap exemption list, so a *.json, *.jsonl or *.log file - tests/python-versions.json, tests/git-versions.json, tasks/CLAIMS.jsonl - can be changed undeclared and nothing reports it. That is a false negative, the opposite of the defect T-0047 closed.
